name: Hua Guichao
profile: Hua Guichao (Dr. Gary Hua) is a power-electronics engineer (Zhejiang University BS/MS; Virginia Tech CPES PhD 1994) who founded Inventronics in 2007, now one of the largest makers of high-efficiency LED drivers; the company entered EV chargers in 2015. He also founded 4D Bios Corp.
interesting_fact: Before Inventronics he co-founded VPT Inc. (military/aerospace power) as VP of Engineering, and founded e-Power Co., later a wholly-owned affiliate of NASDAQ-listed Bel Fuse.
deep_cut_fact: He earned his PhD at Virginia Tech's Center for Power Electronics Systems (CPES) in 1994 and has published 60+ papers and received 80+ patents worldwide.
notes: Goes by 'Gary Hua' in English. Strong fit for energy/EV-charging angle. ISA profile notes a CCTV 2010 Economic Person of the Year nomination (https://isa-world.org/Index/show/catid/14/id/121.html). 2026 reports of share-sale plans unverified.

name: Mohammed Galadari
current_role: London-based hotel/property investor; associated with Blackfriars Hotels Ltd (current title not confirmed)
profile: Mohammed (also spelled Mahomed) Galadari is a London-based developer from Dubai's Galadari family who appears on the Sunday Times Rich List under hotels and property. He bought the Crowne Plaza hotel in Blackfriars, London for £85m via his Blackfriars Hotels company.
interesting_fact: His UK debut was the ~£85m purchase of the Crowne Plaza at Blackfriars in the City of London; his Blackfriars Hotels company had £28.3m assets in 2013 (per Sunday Times Rich List data).
notes: Very low public profile; no personal site or social accounts found. The Blackfriars hotel was later rebranded under Hyatt (Hyatt Regency London Blackfriars, 2023) per search results not directly read. Companies House officer list for Blackfriars Hotels Ltd (03504830) may help confirm current involvement.

name: Zhou Cimei
current_role: Chairman, Huaxiang Group (华翔集团), Xiangshan, Ningbo
profile: Zhou Cimei (b. 1942, Xizhou, Xiangshan) built Huaxiang Group from a 1972 village plastics workshop into an auto-parts group with ~25bn yuan revenue (2020), including listed Ningbo Huaxiang and Huazhong Automotive, now run by his two sons. Near 80 he still personally ran four companies.
interesting_fact: Huaxiang entered auto parts in 1991 by trial-producing China's first domestically made automotive air-conditioning housing, after Zhou chased a Shanghai project for months; in 2007 it bought UK interiors maker Lawrence.
deep_cut_fact: He writes poetry and has spent years building Huaxiang Villa (华翔山庄) in his hometown Xizhou; one line reads '千古山庄是吾身'. His motto: '企业是棵树，根粗壮了才能枝繁叶茂' (a company is a tree; strong roots first).
notes: Alive as of a Nov 2021 Xiangshan government profile. Early career (per maigoo, user-submitted): accountant at Xizhou transport cooperative 1962-66, factory sales manager 1967-79. Best route likely via Ningbo Huaxiang (SZSE-listed) IR. Very local/Chinese-language profile.

name: Yu Haiyan
current_role: Vice President and co-actual controller, China Ficont / 3S Industry (中际联合, SSE: 605305), Beijing
profile: Yu Haiyan is the wife of chairman/president Liu Zhixin and, with him, the actual controller of Ficont (中际联合, brand 3S), which makes wind-turbine tower lifts, climb-assist devices and other high-altitude safety equipment. She was a director 2016-2023 and is now a vice president; the company listed in Shanghai in May 2021.
interesting_fact: Ficont's 3S-branded tower lifts ride inside wind-turbine towers; the company has subsidiaries in the US (3S Americas), India, Hong Kong and the Middle East and is pushing into Europe and Brazil.
notes: Per 2025 annual report she holds no shares directly or indirectly; husband Liu Zhixin holds ~28%. Directly relevant to the wind-energy angle; Liu Zhixin is the public face.

name: Fan Fan
current_role: Vice Chairman and co-actual controller, Chengdu Olymvax Biopharmaceuticals (欧林生物, SSE STAR: 688319)
profile: Fan Fan (b. ~1981) co-controls Chengdu-based vaccine maker Olymvax with her father, chairman Fan Shaowen. Its adsorbed tetanus vaccine drove ~91% of 2024 revenue; the pipeline targets drug-resistant bacteria (S. aureus vaccine in Phase III, oral H. pylori vaccine). Olymvax filed for a Hong Kong dual listing in Nov 2025.
interesting_fact: She came to vaccines from hospitality: undergraduate in international hotel management at Manchester Metropolitan, then an MSc at Imperial College London, CEIBS EMBA and a PhD from Southwest University of Political Science and Law.
deep_cut_fact: When Olymvax was founded she joined as an ordinary employee, starting in basic administration and HR roles before rising to vice chairman.
notes: UK-educated, so an English-language approach via IR may work. Less fit for energy/data-center theme (vaccines).

name: Chen Jianjun
current_role: Chairman of the Board and President, DARE Technology Group (大亚科技集团, 'Dareglobal'); Chairman, Dare Power Dekor Home (大亚圣象, SZSE: 000910)
profile: Chen Jianjun (b. Dec 1972) leads the Danyang, Jiangsu-based DARE group, whose brands include Power Dekor (圣象) flooring, DARE wood panels, packaging, DARE wheels (auto parts) and real estate, with new-materials and new-energy segments. He became group chairman in 2019 after running Power Dekor from 2015.
interesting_fact: DARE's car-wheel business (大亚车轮) is the 'car accessories' source in rich lists; the group now spans home furnishings, smart packaging, new materials and new energy, and DARE wheels exhibited at the 2026 Frankfurt auto-parts fair.
deep_cut_fact: Before joining the family group he worked from 1995 at Zhenjiang's foreign trade company and Danyang's foreign economic and trade commission; he holds a Fudan University MBA and won the 2019 China Forestry Industry Outstanding Contribution Award.
notes: Common name; identity matched via DARE group site listing 陈建军 as chairman/president. Maigoo bio is user-submitted. Avoid the well-reported family control dispute. New-energy segment may be a podcast hook.

name: Liang Yingguang
current_role: Co-actual controller (with spouse Shi Huashan) and shareholder, Hanyu Group (汉宇集团, SZSE: 300403), Jiangmen, Guangdong
profile: Liang Yingguang and husband Shi Huashan are the actual controllers of Hanyu Group, a global leading supplier of energy-efficient drain pumps for washing machines and dishwashers (customers include Whirlpool, Haier, Midea, Samsung). The company is diversifying into smart hydrotherapy toilets and NEV parts including EV charging piles.
interesting_fact: Hanyu is a nationally recognized 'single-item manufacturing champion' that says it broke a foreign technology monopoly in efficient appliance drain pumps; it now also makes electronic water pumps and AC/DC EV chargers.
notes: Not an executive; holds ~0.49% directly (Mar 2026). Husband Shi Huashan is the public face/chairman. Little personal public info.
